annotations.title: DNS lookup: records of a domain

description: DNS lookup of a domain: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS, CAA, SOA and other records through Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS, with TTLs, the response code and DNSSEC validation. Use to check where a domain points, its mail servers or a TXT verification record. Example: name=example.com. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
